description: Source code of the PDO class for database interactions within the Opencart system. Implements connection handling, queries, escaping, and retrieval of last insert ID.

classes.name: PDO
classes.description: A wrapper class for PHP's PDO to handle MySQL database connections and queries, specific to the OpenCart system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection using provided host, username, password, database name, and optional port.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query, returning result data as a stdClass object or boolean indicating success.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Prepares and escapes a string value for safe use in SQL queries.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of affected rows from the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the last inserted row, if available.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is currently active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed.
